mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.user_id AS userId, r.book_id AS bookId, r.status, r.create_time AS createTime, r.expire_time AS expireTime, r.update_time AS updateTime, u.username, u.nickname, b.title AS bookTitle, b.author AS bookAuthor, c.name AS categoryName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation q WHERE q.book_id = r.book_id AND q.status IN ('WAITING', 'READY') AND (q.create_time < r.create_time OR (q.create_time = r.create_time AND q.id <= r.id)) ) AS queueNo, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation q WHERE q.book_id = r.book_id AND q.status IN ('WAITING', 'READY') ) AS queueSize FROM reservation r INNER JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN book b ON r.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (user_id, book_id, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'READY')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'READY')
WHERE r.book_id = #{bookId} AND r.status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY r.create_time ASC, r.id ASC LIMIT 1
WHERE r.status = 'READY' AND r.expire_time IS NOT NULL AND r.expire_time < #{now}
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET status = 'READY', expire_time = #{expireTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'WAITING'
